offers_products.reason: Manufactures tractors, combines, construction and forestry machinery, plus precision-ag software and technology.

offers_services.reason: John Deere Financial provides loans and leases; also digital subscriptions and support services alongside machinery sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells compact tractors, mowers and merchandise to homeowners and small landowners, plus farmers buying as individuals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Farms, contractors, forestry operators, governments and dealers buy agricultural and construction machinery.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is from equipment sales bought every few years; parts, finance and subscriptions are smaller.

cyclical_demand.reason: Farmers and contractors can postpone tractor, combine and construction equipment purchases in downturns or low crop prices.

big_ticket.reason: Combines, tractors and air carts are costly machinery, financed over 60 months and bought infrequently.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured machinery and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are farmers, small contractors and independent dealers, plus households, not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Heavy manufacturing plants plus a large financing portfolio of loans and leases require ongoing capital investment.
